“I have had a few lessons with Jason so far and they have already made me feel much more confident speaking English. What I like the most is that the lessons focus on conversations and situations that I actually face at work. Jason has taught me useful phrases for meetings and I recently used them when I led a meeting in English. I felt much more relaxed and confident than I would have before. I have also noticed an improvement in my pronunciation and I am becoming more aware of how I sound when I speak. Jason is patient, explains everything clearly and always gives examples that are easy to understand and remember. The lessons are practical and get me thinking and talking. After each lesson, he gives me helpful feedback, so I know exactly what I need to improve. I also like the homework he gives me because it helps me to keep practising between lessons. I am looking forward to continuing my lessons with Jason, and I'd definitely recommend him to anyone who wants to improve their English.”
